title: Return Terms for Unopened Supplies — Insulin Pump Program
content:
### What may be returned

Larkfield accepts a return on an Insulin Pump Program only of items that are unopened and in their original sealed packaging. Opened medical supplies are never returned to stock or credited on any tier where opened supplies are not returnable, because a supply that has left Larkfield's control cannot be re-dispensed to another patient. An insulin pump removed from its sealed packaging is opened and never returnable; a malfunctioning pump goes back to its manufacturer only as part of a warranty exchange.

### When a return may be authorized

A return is authorized only when the customer asks for it no later than the return window in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that shipment, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed. A shipment without a proof of delivery cannot be returned, and a package damaged in transit is handled as a replacement, not a return.

### How many units

The units authorized for return never exceed the units of that shipment, less any units of it already authorized for return.

### What happens on receipt

When the warehouse accepts the returned units as unopened and sealed, the units are credited back to the authorization they were drawn from. A payer-billed shipment is then re-billed by a void claim (all units returned) or a corrected claim (some units returned), and a self-pay shipment is credited to the customer's balance at the price paid for the returned units less the restocking fee percent. Returned units the warehouse finds opened are not accepted and no receipt is recorded.

### Cases (hypothetical; 30-day window, delivery on day D)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Request on day D plus 30, sealed box | Return may be authorized |
| Request on day D plus 31 | Not authorized — outside the window |
| No proof of delivery on file | Cannot be returned |
| Shipment of 20 units, 5 already authorized for return, customer asks for 20 | At most 15 units may be authorized |
| Payer-billed shipment, all units received back sealed | Units credited back; void claim |
| Payer-billed shipment, some units received back sealed | Units credited back; corrected claim |
| Self-pay shipment, customer paid $50.00 for the units received back sealed, 15% restocking fee | Balance credited $42.50 |
